question: A can do (1)/(3) of a work in 4 days and B can do (3)/(4) of the work in 15 days. Together, they will complete the work in
solution:
Given:

A can do (1)/(3) of a work in 4 days 

A can do whole work in = 4 × 3 = 12 days

B can do (3)/(4) of the work in 15 days. 

B can do whole work in = 15 × (4)/(3) = 20 days

Formula used:

**Work = Time × Efficiency**

Calculation:

One day work of A = 1/12

One day work of B = 1/20

Let together they take x days

One day work of A and B = 1/x

According to the question,

⇒ 1/12 + 1/20 = 1/x

⇒ (20 + 12)/ 240 = 1/x

⇒ 32x = 240

⇒ x = 30/4

⇒ x = 15/2 = 7(1)/(2) days

Hence, the correct answer is "7(1)/(2) days".
